title: Whole slide image based deep learning refines prognosis and therapeutic response evaluation in lung adenocarcinoma
summary: Deep learning on histopathology whole-slide images predicts recurrence risk in lung adenocarcinoma, validated in independent multicenter cohorts with a suitable prognostic evaluation. The result is limited to the reported study population and evaluation; the source does not establish transfer to other populations or improved clinical outcomes.
